templates.title: Uptime Kuma
templates.name: uptime-kuma
templates.description: A self-hosted monitoring tool: checks websites, ports and services, and notifies you when they go down.
templates.note: Open port 3001 and create the first account: it becomes the administrator.

templates.title: Vaultwarden
templates.name: vaultwarden
templates.description: A lightweight server for Bitwarden password manager clients.

env.name: DOMAIN
env.label: Address
env.description: The https:// address clients use to reach it, e.g. https://vault.example.com.

templates.note: Bitwarden's web vault and apps need HTTPS: put it behind a reverse proxy with a certificate. Turn off new accounts once yours exists.

templates.title: Gitea
templates.name: gitea
templates.description: A painless self-hosted Git service, with issues, pull requests, packages and actions.
templates.note: Open port 3000 to finish the setup. SQLite is fine to start with; Git over SSH uses port 2222.

templates.title: Jellyfin
templates.name: jellyfin
templates.description: A free media server for your films, series, music and photos, with apps for most devices.
templates.note: Point the media volume at the host folder that holds your library (a path starting with /).

templates.title: Home Assistant
templates.name: homeassistant
templates.description: Open-source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
templates.note: It uses the host's network, so it can find devices on your network. Open port 8123 on the host.

templates.title: Pi-hole
templates.name: pihole
templates.description: A DNS sinkhole that blocks ads and trackers for every device on your network.

env.name: FTLCONF_webserver_api_password
env.label: Admin password
env.description: For the web interface on port 8053.

templates.note: Port 53 must be free on the host: on many Linux systems systemd-resolved holds it.

templates.title: AdGuard Home
templates.name: adguardhome
templates.description: Network-wide ad and tracker blocking DNS server, with a web interface.
templates.note: Open port 3000 for the first setup; after that the interface is on port 8083. Port 53 must be free on the host.

templates.title: Grafana
templates.name: grafana
templates.description: Dashboards and alerts for metrics, logs and traces from Prometheus and many other sources.
templates.note: Sign in with admin / admin on port 3002, then choose a new password.

templates.title: Prometheus
templates.name: prometheus
templates.description: A monitoring system and time-series database that scrapes metrics from your services.
templates.note: It starts with a configuration that scrapes only itself. Mount your own prometheus.yml at /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml by editing the stack.

templates.title: PostgreSQL
templates.name: postgres
templates.description: The open-source relational database.

env.name: POSTGRES_DB
env.label: Database
env.description: Created on first start; defaults to the user name.

templates.note: The password is only read when the volume is empty, on the first start.

templates.title: MariaDB
templates.name: mariadb
templates.description: A community-developed fork of MySQL.

env.name: MARIADB_USER
env.label: User name
env.description: Gets every right on that database.

templates.note: The passwords are only read when the volume is empty, on the first start.

templates.title: Valkey
templates.name: valkey
templates.description: An open-source key-value store, compatible with Redis.
templates.note: It has no password: publish the port only on a trusted network, or not at all for other stacks' use.

templates.title: Nginx
templates.name: nginx
templates.description: A web server, for static sites and as a reverse proxy.
templates.note: Put your site in the html volume, or point it at a host folder.

templates.title: Caddy
templates.name: caddy
templates.description: A web server and reverse proxy that gets HTTPS certificates by itself.
templates.note: It serves a welcome page until you mount a Caddyfile at /etc/caddy/Caddyfile by editing the stack.

templates.title: Syncthing
templates.name: syncthing
templates.description: Continuous file synchronisation between your devices, without a cloud in between.
templates.note: The interface on port 8384 has no password at first: set one under Actions, Settings, GUI.

templates.title: FreshRSS
templates.name: freshrss
templates.description: A self-hosted RSS and Atom feed reader, with apps through its API.

env.name: CRON_MIN
env.label: Refresh at minutes
env.description: When feeds are refreshed each hour.

templates.title: Nextcloud
templates.name: nextcloud
templates.description: Files, calendars, contacts and much more, on your own server.
templates.note: Open port 8084 to create the administrator. SQLite suits one or two users; choose PostgreSQL or MariaDB for more.

templates.title: IT Tools
templates.name: it-tools
templates.description: Handy tools for developers in the browser: encoders, converters, generators and more.

templates.title: Dozzle
templates.name: dozzle
templates.description: A small web interface for following container logs live.
templates.note: It reads the engine's socket, which gives it control of the host even when mounted read-only. Don't publish it where others can reach it.

templates.title: Whoami
templates.name: whoami
templates.description: A tiny web server that prints what it knows about each request. Handy for testing proxies and networks.
